translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The frame narrator and Marlow are kept apart; Marlow’s tale keeps the source’s quotation marks, including its irregularities.
decisions.rationale: The nested narration is the work’s structure.

decisions.decision: Conrad’s dense impressionist sentences, repetitions and adjectives of vagueness are kept; em dashes unspaced; English units kept.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: A dropped negation (‘nor even respect’), the comparison in the fog passage, ‘a day’s purchase’, ‘glassy panel’, the Master’s rank and several shades corrected.
‘The horror! The horror!’ restored to exact doubling; the boy’s ‘he dead’ keeps its contempt (hắn).
Recurring ‘fantastic invasion’ and ‘the Administration’ unified; units of measure made consistent; Kurtz’s address to Marlow unified; spaced dashes removed.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.source_term: The horror! The horror! / Mistah Kurtz—he dead.
glossary.draft_rendering: Ghê rợn! Ghê rợn! / Mít-tơ Kurtz—hắn chết.
glossary.rationale: Exact doubling of Kurtz’s last words; the boy’s line keeps its broken grammar and contempt.

glossary.source_term: pilgrims; the Intended; the sepulchral city; heart of darkness
glossary.draft_rendering: kẻ hành hương; Người Hứa hôn; thành phố như mồ mả; trái tim của bóng tối
glossary.rationale: Conrad’s ironic and recurring names are fixed so their echoes survive.

glossary.draft_rendering: mọi đen / người da đen / người man rợ / thổ dân, as in the source
glossary.rationale: Rendered faithfully, neither softened nor amplified, without added commentary.

witness_decision: Selected the complete text of Project Gutenberg #219. Gutenberg does not identify the printed edition transcribed; the novella was serialised in Blackwood’s Magazine (February–April 1899) and collected in Youth: A Narrative, and Two Other Stories (Blackwood, 1902). Not collated with a print facsimile.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Narration pronouns for the accountant, manager and brickmaker grow more contemptuous over the text, a defensible reading of Marlow’s hostility not fixed by the source.

title_review.rationale: Trái tim của bóng tối echoes the in-text phrase ‘vào trái tim của bóng tối’ as Conrad’s title echoes his text; Tâm bóng tối loses the bodily heart.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Kurtz’s last words and the lie.
